load_recall_metric: load the recall metric module using evaluate.load with the string identifier recall
launch_gradio_widget: launch an interactive gradio widget for the recall metric evaluation module
compute_recall_score: compute recall scores by calling the recall module compute method with predictions and references
combine_recall_with_other_metrics: combine the recall metric with other evaluate metrics using evaluate.combine for multi-metric evaluation
get_recall_module_info: retrieve recall metric module info including description and citation using the loaded module info attribute
